title: Cozy Room in Historic Neighborhood close to City
description:
Oversized bungalow in charming neighborhood with first floor en suite bath/bedroom.  Accommodating hosts who are knowledgeable of Nashville’s offerings and hidden treasures.

The space
This room is a large bedroom with ensuite bathroom and a laundry nook.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the downstairs where the bedroom is located and the garden out back.

During your stay
We do enjoy visiting with our guests, but play it be ear to how much they want to engage.  Since it is our private home we do meet guests upon arrival to help the get settled in.

Other things to note
Please be advised that we have a small dog.
